llc.formation_notes: $110 equals filing fee plus municipality fee; certified copy $50; expedite fees extra (raised by HB 400 from August 1, 2026). A Delaware registered agent is required.

annual_report.name: None for LLCs (annual LLC tax only)
annual_report.due: LLCs file no annual report; the annual tax for the prior year is due on or before June 1
annual_report.late_penalty: $200 penalty plus 1.5% interest per month on tax and penalty

state_tax_on_llc.name: Annual LLC tax
state_tax_on_llc.applies: Every domestic and foreign LLC, LP and GP formed or registered in Delaware, active at any time during the calendar year
state_tax_on_llc.notes: Raised from $300 to $400 by HB 400 (153rd GA, signed May 21, 2026, 85 Del. Laws c. 273), effective January 1, 2026; so the 2026 tax ($400) is due June 1, 2027. No proration.

sources.title: Delaware Division of Corporations Fee Schedule (revised August 1, 2026)
LLC/LP/GP Franchise Tax Instructions - Delaware Division of Corporations
sources.quote: are required to pay an annual tax of $400.00. There is no requirement to file an Annual Report.

sources.title: House Bill 400 (2026)
sources.quote: Sections 9, 16, and 23 of this Act take effect January 1, 2026.

entity_level_taxes.name: Corporate franchise tax + annual report
entity_level_taxes.notes: Minimum $175 under the Authorized Shares Method ($400 minimum under Assumed Par Value Capital Method), max $200,000; plus $50 annual report fee for non-exempt domestic corporations; due March 1. Late: $200 penalty + 1.5%/month.

entity_level_taxes.name: Gross receipts tax (all business forms)
entity_level_taxes.notes: Tax on total gross revenues at 0.0945% to 1.9914% depending on activity, after a monthly/quarterly exclusion generally starting at $100,000 per month. Applies to sole proprietors and LLCs too.

sources.title: Annual Report and Tax Instructions - Delaware Division of Corporations
sources.quote: The minimum tax is currently $175.00, using the Authorized Shares Method

sources.title: Gross Receipts Tax FAQs - Delaware Division of Revenue
sources.quote: Gross receipts tax rates currently range from .0945% to 1.9914%

personal_exemption.notes: Personal credit $110 per federal exemption (plus extra for 60+). Same rate table for all filing statuses; spouses may file a combined separate return (status 4) to use the table twice. Additional $2,500 standard deduction if 65+ or blind.

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: None. HS 2 for HB 13 (new brackets up to 6.95%) remains in House Revenue & Finance Committee, not enacted.

sources.title: Delaware Declaration of Estimated Income Tax for Individuals 2026 - Instructions
Delaware PIT-EST 2026 Instructions
sources.quote: Standard Deduction ($3,250 single, divorced or widow(er), head of household) ($6,500 if married filing jointly)

estimated_tax.required_if: Tax due in excess of withholding can reasonably be expected to exceed $800
estimated_tax.notes: First installment is due April 30 (Delaware's return due date), not April 15. Penalty 1.5% per month on underpayment; safe harbor 100% of prior-year tax (110% if federal AGI over $150,000 per instructions).

unemployment_2026.notes: Employer Services page: 'The taxable wage base in 2026 is $14,500.00' and new employer rate 1.0% for 2026 (1.2% in 2025). The UI employer FAQ (undated) says $18,500, a conflict. A separate 0.2% Operational & Technology assessment is billed separately from 2026.

local_taxes.name: City wage (earned income) tax and net profits tax
local_taxes.applies: Wage tax on residents and on nonresidents working in the city; net profits tax on net profit of sole proprietors and partnerships within city limits (annual Form WCWT-6).

notable: LLC annual tax rose from $300 to $400 for tax year 2026 (HB 400, signed May 21, 2026) - first payment at the new rate due June 1, 2027 (https://corp.delaware.gov/alt-entitytaxinstructions/)
No sales tax but a gross receipts tax on businesses above a $100,000/month exclusion (https://revenue.delaware.gov/business-tax-forms/gross-receipts-tax-faqs/)
First estimated payment is due April 30, two weeks after the federal date (https://revenuefiles.delaware.gov/2025/PITForms_Instructions/Instructions/PIT-EST_Instructions_2026-01.pdf)
uncertain: Wilmington wage and net profits tax rate: 1.25% for both per a City FY2023 budget summary seen only in search results; the city website blocks automated access (403), so the rate is left null.
SUTA wage base conflict on DOL pages ($14,500 dated 2026 vs $18,500 undated FAQ).
No Delaware PTET found (none known); not confirmed on an official page because web search budget ran out.
Delaware state business license fee ($75/year commonly cited) not verified.
